title: Set a specimen pan across a toilet bowl's opening, both wings on the rim, under the raised seat
instruction: Set the specimen pan upright across the toilet bowl opening with both wings on the rim, leaving the raised seat up, then let go and move both hands clear.
context: The hard parts: the pan is turned 90 degrees and set across the bowl's opening: set down lengthwise it drops into the bowl (222.3 x 336.6 mm into an opening about 264 x 379 mm), across it bridges with 36 mm of wing on the rim each side; the 100 mm deep pan is carried over the 16 cm rim and lowered straight in; and the raised seat is left on its check-hinge stop: about 1 N at its front tips it over and it falls shut. A specimen pan under the toilet seat is how a nursing assistant collects urine or stool from a patient who can use the toilet. O*NET 31-1131.00 Nursing Assistants (1,505,900 employed, 2025) lists "Collect specimens, such as urine, feces, or sputum." (https://www.onetonline.org/link/summary/31-1131.00). The toilet is a Kohler K-4302 Highcrest elongated bowl's geometry with the wall behind it, the seat a Bemis 1955CT commercial open-front seat, the pan a Medline 30 oz specimen collector pan.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases, x forward, y left. The toilet faces the arms, its seat and the wall away from them. A Kohler K-4302 Highcrest elongated bowl's top at the maker's sizes, built as a fixture: a 12 mm white board cut to the bowl's outline, 36.8 cm across (y -22.4 to +14.4) and 66.0 cm back to front (x 7.0 to 73.0), with the opening 26.4 cm across and 37.9 cm long (x 12.2 to 50.2), both cut as rectangles; under it a plywood box of the same outline, 14.8 cm tall, screwed to the bench, its inside under the opening closed by a floor 15.2 cm under the rim (the maker's water depth). The box is the stand: it puts the rim 16.0 cm over the bench and replaces the bowl's pedestal and the floor only (a real rim is 41.9 cm over the floor). A 2 cm board 60 x 70 cm stands upright across the bench at x 77.2, 27-5/8 in. behind the bowl's front (the 10 in. rough-in), as the wall. A Bemis 1955CT seat (white, open front, no cover) is bolted through two holes 5-1/2 in. apart at x 54.1 (y -11.0 and +3.0) and raised on its check hinges 11 degrees past upright, where it stays up. An empty Medline Specimen Collector Pan, 30 oz (DYND36600H) stands upright on the bench, its middle at (28.0, -40.0), lengthwise: its wings along x, its front wall towards the bowl, within 3 mm of two pencil marks at that wall's corners.
scoring: 0.0 for good if at any step the pan falls into the bowl (its lowest point within 8 mm of the water surface, its middle under the opening) or the seat falls from its stop (under 90 deg with no hand within 25 mm of it and not resting on the pan). Otherwise, at the end of the trial: 1.0: the pan across the opening: upright (tilt <= 8 deg), its wings within 20 deg of square across the opening, its middle inside the opening, both wing tips over the side rims with their undersides at most 5 mm over the rim top; the seat up on its stop (at least 99 deg); every part of both hands at least 30 mm from the seat, the pan and the bowl; all held so for 1.0 s (20 steps) with the pan moving at most 1.5 mm and the seat at most 0.5 deg. 0.5: the pan across the opening as above, any 1.0 condition not met. 0.0: otherwise. On the bench: the pan falling in and the seat falling shut from the trial video (the time of each); tilt with a phone inclinometer on the pan's rim; the wings on the rim by eye and with a ruler; the seat on its stop by eye; the hands and the 1.0 s from the video.
reset_notes: Between trials, about 1 minute: lift the pan off the rim (or out of the bowl if it fell in: then a clean pan), raise the seat back onto its stop if it fell shut, and stand the pan lengthwise on its two pencil marks.
fidelity: Rigid bodies in PhysX, 240 Hz. Bowl: fixed boxes with the maker's outline, wall and water depth; its oval rim and opening drawn as rectangles, its curved inside as a straight well to a flat water surface; the flush valve behind the raised seat left out. Seat: one rigid ring of boxes with the maker's sizes and 1.91 kg on a free hinge to its stop at 101 deg. Pan: a rigid 4 mm shell with the listed sizes. Grippy friction (1.2/1.0) on seat and pan. No liquid. Nothing is welded or placed.
